observation_summary: The application throws a java.lang.OutOfMemoryError due to an infinite loop during pattern parsing.
reasoning_summary: The code responsible for parsing quoted strings in the pattern failed to advance the parse position when encountering an escaped quote. Because the index was not incremented, the parser repeatedly re-processed the same character, leading to an infinite loop that eventually exhausted the heap memory. The fix involves calling the 'next(pos)' method to advance the parser's index after processing the quote, ensuring the loop terminates.
